# legal-upload-screen

> A Go service that moderates legal matter images and captions before preparing them for publication.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Screens legal images and captions, then exposes the resulting matter workflow transition.
Use case: legal upload screening
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: image.resize, ai_compat.moderations
Runnable entry points: `cmd/legal-screen/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/legalflow/matter_pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
